title: %compound - future value of a lump sum
purpose: Grow a principal at a per-period rate over n periods: P x (1 + r)^n.
notes: Arguments are principal, then rate, then periods, in that order.
The rate is a per-period fraction: 5% is 0.05, not 5.
Output is a TS shortest-round-trip float (last-digit f64 differs cross-language); verified in TS only.

avoid.why: a rate given as 5 (meaning 500%) instead of 0.05 returns ~604661760000 - express the rate as a fraction
rate and periods are swapped; the engine computes 10000 x (1+10)^0.05 = ~11273.78, not the intended growth
